description: The chart illustrates percent-point differences for two multilingual models across four probe architecture settings, showing paired bars for mBERT and XLM-R in each setting. The horizontal axis contains the categorical probe configurations in left-to-right order: “hidden:[50], linear,” “hidden:[], linear,” “hidden:[100], ReLU,” and “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU.” The vertical axis is labeled “% point difference” and uses a linear scale spanning approximately from −0.2 to +0.2, with regularly spaced tick marks at about 0.1 intervals (−0.2, −0.1, 0.0, 0.1, 0.2). Each category has two adjacent bars: mBERT is shown in a light cyan/teal bar with a hatched texture, and XLM-R is shown in a darker solid blue bar, as indicated by the legend in the upper right. For “hidden:[50], linear,” the mBERT bar extends down to about −0.20 and the XLM-R bar to about −0.06; for “hidden:[], linear,” the mBERT bar rises to about +0.09 and the XLM-R bar to about +0.21; for “hidden:[100], ReLU,” the mBERT bar is around −0.11 while the XLM-R bar is slightly above zero at roughly +0.03; and for “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU,” the mBERT bar is near −0.18 and the XLM-R bar near −0.14. The bars are grouped side-by-side (not stacked), there is no visible sorting beyond the presented left-to-right category order, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the consistent color/texture encoding and the presence of horizontal gridlines.
